newsitem.title: ITALY: Envoy joins search for Italians in Grozny.
newsitem.headline: Envoy joins search for Italians in Grozny.

text.p: Italy has sent an envoy to the Chechen capital of Grozny to help find three Italian aid workers who disappeared last week, the foreign ministry said on Tuesday.
A ministry spokesman said an employee of Italy's embassy in Moscow had left for Grozny on Monday to coordinate the search.
The Italians were last seen on September 26 when they set off by car from Nazran in Ingushetia, a region bordering on Chechnya, to deliver medicine and equipment to a war-damaged hospital in Grozny.
The non-governmental group INTERSOS, for whom the men worked, said in a statement on Sunday that after they failed to arrive in Grozny, it suspected they had been kidnapped.
INTERSOS identified the men as Sandro Pocaterra, 41, who had been the group's representative in Chechnya since February, and two doctors, Augusto Lombardo, 36, and Giuseppe Valenti, 62.
